title: XOR-mask decreasing subsequence lengths
body:
## Summary
- Every XOR mask in dimensions 1 through 12 has longest decreasing subsequence exactly `2` to its Hamming weight: 8,190 masks.
- Every pair of masks through dimension 10 obeys `wt(a xor b) + 2 wt(a and b) = wt(a) + wt(b)`, so the composed length is at most the product of the two lengths: 1,398,100 pairs.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
